scope: Source-only rebuild modules for AC04 Normal missions 6-12 (Invincible Fleet, Deep Strike, Shattered Skies, Operation Bunker Shot, Tango Line, Escort, Stonehenge Offensive). NOT integrated, NOT built, NOT run in Roblox Studio or Player, NOT published. Native procedural parts/terrain only; no imported or Blender assets; no uploads.
